summary: Mason County, WA site: 1956 cab on a 10-ft concrete block base, staffed into the 1960s; removed or destroyed 1976; footings removed 2003. FFLOS-registered 2012.

facts.design: cab on a 10-foot concrete block base
facts.status_note: The cab was removed or destroyed in 1976, and the footings were removed in 2003.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 3,070 ft (936 m). A 1956 newspaper item quoted by the Forest Lookouts index says 3,100 feet. The story uses the register figure.
The register says removed in 1976, firelookout.com says destroyed in 1976, and WillhiteWeb says removed or destroyed. The story uses removed or destroyed, with 1976 as the date.

notes_for_editor: Build (1956), replacement of Simpson and 1976 removal agree across sources. Staffing names come from WillhiteWeb alone. The brief kind 'two_story' is not stated in any source; they describe a cab on a 10-foot concrete block base. Editor should check that kind field. Brief record otherwise matches.
